prompts.text: Count from 1 to 20, separated by single spaces. Output only the numbers.
Write the English alphabet in lowercase with no spaces. Output only the letters.
Repeat this string exactly and output nothing else: q7-Zeta/41_blue.kestrel
List the days of the week starting with Monday, separated by commas. Output only the list.
Write the first 12 prime numbers separated by commas. Output only the numbers.
Spell the word 'thermodynamics' backwards. Output only the reversed word.
What is 4817 + 2956? Output only the number.
What is 37 * 43? Output only the number.
Sort these words alphabetically and output them separated by spaces: pear, fig, quince, apple, mango, lime
Convert 255 to binary. Output only the binary digits.
Output a JSON object with keys "a", "b" and "c" whose values are 1, 2 and 3. Output only the JSON on one line.
How many letters are in the word 'inference'? Output only the number.
Write one sentence about a lighthouse at night.
Name a color, an animal and a city, separated by commas.
Invent a name for a bakery and give it a one-line slogan.
Describe the taste of a lemon in ten words or fewer.
Give one unusual use for a paperclip in a single sentence.
Write the first line of a poem about rain.
Suggest a title for a novel about a clockmaker.
Pick a number between 1 and 1000 and say why in a few words.
